device_template.name: Huawei DTSU666-H meter (via SUN2000)
device_template.model: DTSU666-H / DDSU666-H power meter behind a SUN2000
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: The grid meter a Huawei SUN2000 reads on its own RS485 bus (DTSU666-H three-phase or DDSU666-H single-phase), served by the INVERTER at 37100-37137: status, phase and line voltages, phase currents, total and per-phase active power, reactive power, PF, frequency, exported/imported and reactive energy. Add it as a second device on the same connection and unit ID as the huawei_sun2000 device, only where the site has the meter. Sign: Huawei counts + as export (feed-in); this template inverts active power and phase currents with a negative scale so they follow the gateway's meter convention, + = import from the grid; register 37119 (Huawei's 'positive' energy) is the export counter, 37121 the import counter. Reactive power keeps Huawei's sign. Field notes: enable Modbus TCP on the SDongle in FusionSolar (Dongle parameters -> Modbus TCP -> Enable unrestricted); unit ID = the inverter's RS485 address (usually 1); the dongle serves ONE Modbus client only, so keep a single gateway connection and poll every 10-30 s; port 502 on the SDongle, 6607 on the inverter's own WLAN access point; Modbus RTU direct on the inverter's RS485 is 9600 8N1. The inverter is the master of its RS485 bus to the DTSU666 meter: never add a second master there, use the listen-only rtu_tap mode to watch it. SunSpec (40000) is a quick alternative without battery, meter or alarms.
device_template.source_document: Huawei 'Solar Inverter Modbus Interface Definitions', power meter registers 37100-37137; cross-read against wlcrs/huawei-solar-lib (grid_exported_energy 37119, grid_accumulated_energy 37121, power_meter_active_power 37113). Not yet checked on hardware.

notes.text: Not yet checked on hardware: with the sun on and the house light, power_active_total must be negative (export) when FusionSolar shows feed-in.
Signs: Huawei reports + for export. Active power and the phase currents are inverted here (negative scale), so + = import, as every grid meter in the gateway.
Without a meter the inverter answers 0 or 'illegal data address' here; do not add this device then. Same connection as the inverter: the SDongle takes one client.
